title: Poll a VCF Operations for Networks bulk application save to a terminal state
prompt:
Implement the exported Save-VcfOnDiscoveredApplication function in src/VcfOpsNetworks.Applications/VcfOpsNetworks.Applications.psm1. It saves every discovered application of one discovery source in VCF Operations for Networks and waits for the resulting bulk save task to finish. The authoritative request shape is docs/contract.json, projected from the pinned VCF Operations for Networks OpenAPI specification recorded in docs/official_sources.json; where a path-level example in that specification disagrees with the referenced component schema, the component schema wins.

Use four operations in this order: create (POST /api/ni/auth/token), getDiscoveredApplications (GET /api/ni/groups/discovered-applications), saveDiscoveredApplications (POST /api/ni/groups/discovered-applications/save), and getBulkApplicationTaskProgress (GET /api/ni/groups/task/progress/{requestId}).

The environment installs the genuine VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Ops PowerCLI module 13.5.0.25380678 as a prerequisite; do not vendor, replace or intercept it. Every request must go through the already-written New-NiApiConnection, New-NiRequestOptions and Invoke-NiRequest helpers, which wrap that module's OpenAPI binding layer. Do not use Invoke-RestMethod, Invoke-WebRequest, WebClient, curl or another direct HTTP client. Those helpers add nothing to a request on their own, so everything on the wire comes from the RequestOptions you build. That client does not raise on a non-success HTTP status, so inspect StatusCode yourself and throw an error naming the operation and the HTTP status.

create declares `security: []` and must be sent with no Authorization header. Every later request carries `Authorization: NetworkInsight {token}` using the token from the create response, verbatim and unencoded. Send username and password; include domain only when the caller bound DomainType or DomainValue, and inside it include domain_type and value only when the matching parameter was bound.

getDiscoveredApplications always carries discovery_type. Carry size only when PageSize was bound and granularity only when Granularity was bound. Follow pagination: repeat the request while the previous response returned a cursor, sending that cursor value as the cursor query parameter, and keep the same optional parameters on every page. Collect the entity_id of every result across all pages, in order.

saveDiscoveredApplications sends discovered_apps as one object per collected entity id with a single source_entity_id field, plus discovery_type. If discovery returns no results, send discovered_apps as an empty array and continue the same workflow. Send enable_intent only when the caller bound EnableIntent, and then as a real JSON boolean; when it is unbound the field must be absent so the server applies its documented default. An unset optional field anywhere in this task means the key never reaches the wire: no nulls, no empty strings, no empty objects, and no query parameters with empty values.

The save response is an acknowledgement only. Poll getBulkApplicationTaskProgress with the request_id it returned, as a single path segment, waiting PollIntervalSeconds between polls, until the task is terminal: progress has reached 100, or status is FINISHED or FAILED. FAILED is terminal even when progress is below 100, so stop polling immediately on it. Throw when the terminal status is not FINISHED, naming that status. If the task never becomes terminal within TimeoutSeconds, stop polling and throw an error that says it timed out; TimeoutSeconds is an upper bound on polling, so do not sleep past it and issue another progress request.

On success return a PSCustomObject with RequestId, Status, Progress, TaskName, PollCount (how many progress requests were made), DiscoveredEntityIds (every collected entity id in order) and SavedApplications (the app_save_response entries from the terminal poll, with their response field names and values intact). Keep the existing public parameter block and the module manifest compatible, and leave docs/, tests/ and the manifest unchanged.
